hero.title: Hot Meals, Zero Distance
hero.description: Order from your favorite restaurants and get your food delivered fast, fresh, and right to your door.

restaurants.title: Explore Local Restaurants
restaurants.description: Browse a wide selection of restaurants, from local favorites to trending spots. Whatever you're craving, we've got it.

delivery.title: Fast & Reliable Delivery
delivery.description: Our riders ensure quick and safe delivery, keeping your food fresh and right on time.

how.title: How It Works
how.description:
1. Choose your meal
2. Place your order
3. Track it in real time
4. Enjoy your food at home

riders.title: Become a Rider
riders.description: Deliver food on your schedule and earn money with flexible hours.
